source: Tester manual runtime session, followed by static source cross-check of the selected v1.0.2 artifact.

observations.note: Runtime proves stale Station 3 chest contents can survive into Station 4. Source shows a reset path exists, so exact timing/ownership failure remains an implementation detail, not a validation blocker.
Runtime symptom and static cause both close: Fortify restores spruce gate; Loadout Trial does not reopen it; NPC break rules reject spruce.
Loadout Trial already exposes threat count in persistent preview HUD. Fortify computes wave size but does not show incoming count during build preparation; note narrowed to this actual gap.
Capture Run lacks playerLeave carrier cleanup and suppresses enemy flag respawn while stale carrierPlayerId remains.
Generic cinematic state advances and completes while player is offline. Stations 2/3 NPC block-breaking failure is the reproduced downstream symptom; all Circuit stations require regression coverage.
Current service animates attacker entity but provides no target-block progress visualization.
Crafting restriction is retained as an optional gameplay-policy hardening action under the existing DebugStick reachability mismatch rather than a duplicate root cause.

followUpRegression: Station 3 → Station 4 chest reset across all arenas and final-tier handoff timing.
Station 4 shared gate open state for every tier/retry and all arenas.
Station 5 flag carrier disconnect before/after pickup, reconnect, death, timeout and reload.
Disconnect during each gameplay cinematic: Combat, Last Stand, Fortify, Loadout Trial, Capture Run.
NPC block breaking after cinematic disconnect/reconnect on Stations 2, 3 and 4.
